Messages.Author: shaggy119
Messages.Body:
Hey, new to the game and have been buying cards. This one seemed broken any ideas if it is a gross as it sounds?

Thanks in advance.

[ACTION MODIFIER] Only usable at the end of a successful action (after resolving the action). Untap this imbued.

[REACTION] [1 CONVICTION] Only usable by a tapped imbued. Untap this imbued.

Messages.Author: Adonai
Messages.Body:
> shaggy119 wrote:
> This one seemed broken any ideas if it is a gross as it sounds?
>
It is not gross, it is not broken.
Think of it as a Rutor's Hand for minions that have a very difficult time gaining life.

It is a lynchpin though, if you can block your predator or prey getting one, then that is definitely the action to block on that turn.

See also:
vtes-hunter-net.tripod.com/

Messages.Author: Boris The Blade
Messages.Body:
Maybe you missed the rule that states you have to tap a power to use a timed effect on it?

www.vekn.net/index.php/rulebook/appendix-imbued-rules
Section 3: Powers.

So no, it is not as gross as it sounds.
